sentences.text: Steve Miner, the film's director makes a cameo as a newscaster at the start of the film.
The film also features a cameo appearance from Corey Feldman, who portrayed Tommy Jarvis in the previous film.
Corey Feldman was only able to make a cameo appearance in the film as a result of his involvement as an actor in The Goonies, which was released the same year as A New Beginning.

Feldman filmed the inserts of his cameo on a Sunday, as that was his off day of shooting his other film, and the footage was shot in the backyard of his family's home in Los Angeles with a rain machine.
